title: Mahalia Jackson's birth chart
metaDescription: Mahalia Jackson's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 2.2° Scorpio. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Venus and Jupiter sit 0.0° from an exact sextile — near enough that the tradition reads taste and expansion as a single working part. Sextiles are read as standing invitations — productive exactly as often as they are accepted.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 2.2° Scorpio. That falls in the first decan, 0°–10°, sub-ruled by Mars in the classical scheme — a water sign read through a fixed season.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Mercury holds 4.1° Scorpio, Venus holds 20.2° Virgo, Mars holds 10.4° Gemini — in the old shorthand, a mind that absorbs before it argues; taste for the substantial and the lasting; drive that argues its way forward.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Venus and Jupiter — a sextile holding at 0.0°. A sextile is an offer rather than a given: available when it is reached for, quiet when it is not. Behind it, Uranus opposition Neptune at 1.8°, and the Sun conjunction Mercury at 1.9° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These angles were checked through every hour of that civil day and survive throughout, which is why an unrecorded hour does not disturb them.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The classical table has one entry for this chart. Venus in Virgo at 20.2° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given. The old table grades terrain, not talent — a placement in fall works uphill, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 4 water, 3 earth, 2 air, 1 fire by element and 4 fixed, 4 mutable, 2 cardinal by mode. Water signs hold memory in the scheme, where nothing is quite finished and little is genuinely forgotten. Mars, Saturn and Pluto were retrograde — apparent retreat against the stars, which the old reading takes as a function working from the inside first.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Sagittarius for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 11.9° between midnight and midnight. The sign survives the missing hour; the degree does not, and is given as a reference rather than a fact. At the noon reference it stands at 23.8°.
